WITH fmi AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fid,
         AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS avg_fmi
  FROM interactions GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot),
prof AS (
  SELECT f.nick_label,
         (m.spending_profile->>'total_spend_usd')::numeric AS total_spend,
         COALESCE((ev.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::numeric,0)
           + COALESCE((ev.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::numeric,0) * 1.5
           + COALESCE((ev.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::numeric,0) * 2 AS eps,
         l.loyalty_snapshot->>'reward_tier' AS reward_tier,
         fmi.avg_fmi
  FROM fans f
  JOIN fmi ON fmi.fid = f.user_registry
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
  JOIN eventsandclub ev ON ev.events_member_pivot = m.member_reg
  LEFT JOIN loyaltyandachievements l ON l.loyalty_events_pivot = ev.events_reg)
SELECT nick_label, ROUND(total_spend,2) AS total_spending_usd, eps AS event_participation_score, reward_tier AS loyalty_reward_tier
FROM prof
WHERE avg_fmi > 20 AND eps > 25
ORDER BY total_spend DESC

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN (sf.feedback_data->>'NPS_Val')::int BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Platform Promoters'
              WHEN (sf.feedback_data->>'NPS_Val')::int BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN 'Detractors' END AS fan_segment,
         c.merch_spend_usd::numeric / NULLIF((m.spending_profile->>'total_spend_usd')::numeric,0) AS mas
  FROM supportandfeedback sf
  JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg = sf.support_interact_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_fan_pivot = i.interact_fan_pivot
  JOIN commerceandcollection c ON c.commerce_member_pivot = m.member_reg)
SELECT fan_segment, ROUND(AVG(mas),2) AS avg_merchandise_affinity_score
FROM seg WHERE fan_segment IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY fan_segment

WITH lurkers AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fid
  FROM interactions
  WHERE sess_dur_min > 0
  GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
  HAVING AVG(watch_hrs::numeric / sess_dur_min) > 0.5
     AND AVG((chat_activity->>'Chat_Msg')::numeric / sess_dur_min) < 0.5)
SELECT e.cont_pref AS content_preference, COUNT(DISTINCT l.fid) AS engaged_lurker_count
FROM lurkers l
JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot = l.fid
JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_activity_pivot = i.activity_reg
GROUP BY e.cont_pref
ORDER BY engaged_lurker_count DESC

WITH im AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fid,
         AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS fmi,
         AVG(watch_hrs::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS cci
  FROM interactions GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot),
ps AS (
  SELECT m.member_fan_pivot AS fid,
         AVG(((p.usage_metrics->>'Int_Consist')::numeric + (p.usage_metrics->>'Plat_Stable')::numeric)/2) AS pss
  FROM preferencesandsettings p JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = p.preferences_member_pivot
  GROUP BY m.member_fan_pivot),
base AS (
  SELECT f.user_registry, f.nick_label, ps.pss, im.fmi, im.cci
  FROM fans f JOIN ps ON ps.fid = f.user_registry JOIN im ON im.fid = f.user_registry),
pr AS (
  SELECT user_registry, nick_label,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pss) AS pss_pct,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fmi) AS fmi_pct,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cci) AS cci_pct
  FROM base),
hr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.interact_fan_pivot AS fid
  FROM retentionandinfluence r
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = r.retain_engage_pivot
  JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg = e.engage_activity_pivot
  WHERE r.churn_flag = 'High')
SELECT pr.nick_label, ROUND(pr.pss_pct::numeric,3) AS pss_percentile, ROUND(pr.fmi_pct::numeric,3) AS fmi_percentile, ROUND(pr.cci_pct::numeric,3) AS cci_percentile
FROM pr JOIN hr ON hr.fid = pr.user_registry
ORDER BY pr.pss_pct ASC

WITH fmi AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fid,
         AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS avg_fmi
  FROM interactions GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot),
superfans AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.user_registry AS fid, f.reg_moment::date AS reg_date
  FROM fans f
  JOIN fmi ON fmi.fid = f.user_registry
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
  JOIN eventsandclub ev ON ev.events_member_pivot = m.member_reg
  WHERE fmi.avg_fmi > 20
    AND COALESCE((ev.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::numeric,0)
      + COALESCE((ev.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::numeric,0) * 1.5
      + COALESCE((ev.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::numeric,0) * 2 > 25),
daily AS (
  SELECT s.fid, (i.time_mark::date - s.reg_date) AS day_no,
         SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) AS day_spend
  FROM superfans s JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot = s.fid
  GROUP BY s.fid, (i.time_mark::date - s.reg_date)),
cum AS (
  SELECT fid, day_no, SUM(day_spend) OVER (PARTITION BY fid ORDER BY day_no) AS cum_spend
  FROM daily),
ms AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (7, '7 days'), (30, '30 days'), (90, '90 days')) v(d, milestone))
SELECT ms.milestone, ROUND(AVG(c.cum_spend), 2) AS avg_cumulative_spend
FROM ms LEFT JOIN cum c ON c.day_no BETWEEN 0 AND ms.d
GROUP BY ms.d, ms.milestone
ORDER BY ms.d

WITH p AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fid,
         MAX((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min,0)) AS pmi
  FROM interactions GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot)
SELECT f.nick_label, f.user_registry AS fan_id, ROUND(p.pmi,2) AS peak_monetization_index,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.pmi DESC) AS fan_rank
FROM p JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = p.fid
WHERE p.pmi > 20
ORDER BY p.pmi DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH m AS (
  SELECT f.user_registry, f.nick_label,
         (s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric / NULLIF((s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric,0) AS ffr,
         SQRT((s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric * (r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach')::numeric) AS cii
  FROM socialcommunity s
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = s.social_engage_pivot
  JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
  JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg = e.engage_activity_pivot
  JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = i.interact_fan_pivot
  WHERE (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric > 0)
SELECT nick_label, ROUND(cii,2) AS community_influence_index, ROUND(ffr,2) AS follower_following_ratio,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cii DESC) AS influence_rank
FROM m WHERE ffr > 2.0 AND cii > 10000
ORDER BY influence_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sls AS (
  SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot AS fid,
         SUM(COALESCE((sf.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix')::numeric,0) + COALESCE((sf.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs')::numeric,0) + COALESCE((sf.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt')::numeric,0)) AS sls
  FROM supportandfeedback sf JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg = sf.support_interact_pivot
  GROUP BY i.interact_fan_pivot),
churn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.interact_fan_pivot AS fid
  FROM retentionandinfluence r
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = r.retain_engage_pivot
  JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg = e.engage_activity_pivot
  WHERE r.churn_flag = 'High'),
cat AS (
  SELECT f.user_registry,
         CASE WHEN c.fid IS NOT NULL THEN 'At-Risk' ELSE 'Not At-Risk' END AS churn_status,
         CASE WHEN s.sls > 10 THEN 'High-Maintenance' ELSE 'Low-Maintenance' END AS support_status
  FROM fans f LEFT JOIN sls s ON s.fid = f.user_registry LEFT JOIN churn c ON c.fid = f.user_registry)
SELECT churn_status, support_status, COUNT(DISTINCT user_registry) AS fan_count
FROM cat GROUP BY churn_status, support_status

WITH collectors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot AS fid
  FROM commerceandcollection c
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = c.commerce_member_pivot
  WHERE COALESCE(c.dig_own,0) + COALESCE(c.phys_own,0) > 50 AND c.coll_comp_rate > 75)
SELECT v.genre_tag AS idol_genre, COUNT(DISTINCT col.fid) AS collector_fan_count
FROM collectors col
JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot = col.fid
JOIN virtualidols v ON v.entity_reg = i.interact_idol_pivot
GROUP BY v.genre_tag
ORDER BY collector_fan_count DESC

WITH influencers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.interact_fan_pivot AS fid
  FROM socialcommunity s
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = s.social_engage_pivot
  JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
  JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg = e.engage_activity_pivot
  WHERE (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric > 0
    AND (s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric / (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric > 2.0
    AND SQRT((s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric * (r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach')::numeric) > 10000),
key_int AS (
  SELECT i.activity_reg, i.interact_idol_pivot, i.time_mark
  FROM interactions i JOIN influencers inf ON inf.fid = i.interact_fan_pivot),
session_msgs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.activity_reg, o.chat_activity->>'Msg_Tone' AS tone
  FROM key_int k
  JOIN interactions o ON o.interact_idol_pivot = k.interact_idol_pivot
   AND o.time_mark BETWEEN k.time_mark - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND k.time_mark + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM influencers x WHERE x.fid = o.interact_fan_pivot))
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tone = 'Positive') AS positive_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tone = 'Negative') AS negative_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tone = 'Neutral') AS neutral_count
FROM session_msgs
note: No two interactions with the same idol fall within 5 minutes of each other in this data, so the result is all zeros whatever the interpretation. Counts are distinct non-influencer interactions by Msg_Tone.
